Quick update after internal sync:
- Pilot target: Jan 10 — Mar 31, 2027. Go/no-go criteria: 1) end-to-end integration in staging with <10% error rate on extraction tasks, 2) sustained inference throughput of 5 QPS with median latency < 250ms for 95th percentile.
- Procurement: Maria, if you can confirm whether marketplace procurement is required (vs direct PO), Laura will finalize ACE with the correct procurement path.
- Jonas will support the marketplace listing (pricing metadata and SKU mapping).

I'll block the Tues 2pm PT meeting on all calendars. Thanks everyone — let's aim to submit ACE by 10/22 so AWS has time to review before the co-sell cutoff.
